notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Exhibition mode
notes.notes:
I just uploaded a new build. It contains a few bugfixes and improves font rendering on some machines. I also updated all of the underlying libs - which should result in better compatibility with non-Windows OSes.

This update introduces a new option - Exhibition mode. It works by automatically restarting the game after 1.5 minutes of inactivity. It's great for exhibitions, where various people come and play for a while. I added it because Prophour23 was presented at an independent art festival in Poland.

Keep your hearts alive!

notes.title: Update 1.1, Android version
notes.notes:
Changes:
- added Daily Challenges. You can play a new Daily game every day, but only once. Other players will face the same challenge as you. There's also a separate leaderboard for each day.
- two new achievements.
- balancing and bugfixes.

P23 is also available on Android tablets now!
https://developer.android.com/images/brand/en_app_rgb_wo_60.png

Enjoy and good luck with the Daily Struggles!

notes.title: Release date: 22 Oct!
notes.notes:
Prophour23 is done! I put in the last piece of music (it's bizarre... I love it), which was the last missing part. All other assets and features are already in. As for the Steamworks, I implemented Achievements (10), Steam Cloud saving and a Leaderboard. I added Trading Cards as well. The integration went much faster than expected, thanks to the helpful & lovely Puppygames!

So, does that mean that the game is ready? Not yet! There are still some bugs waiting for a fix; I hope to clean them up during this last week before release.
